subject: MAP: hosting selection — evaluation cadence & close-breakdown
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@mediq.com>
Cc: Ben Lowe <ben.lowe@mediq.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: hosting selection — evaluation cadence & close-breakdown

Hi Amy —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and an at-a-glance hosting comparison (hosted / dedicated / private). The goal here is to make the tradeoffs explicit so your procurement and security teams can sign off without back-and-forth.

Quick overview:
- Proposed evaluation window: 4 weeks (POC + perf/cost telemetry)
- Decision cadence: weekly syncs with a final decision checkpoint in week 5
- Recommendation (prelim): start on Hosted for speed, reserve Dedicated for PHI-sensitive flows or expected high QPS; Private only if policy requires on-premise data residency

Please find: 2026-07-14_MEDIQ_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx (cost/latency matrix), draft-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (editable).

Ask: Could you share the procurement timeline and any minimum security evidence they’ll need during week 1? I’ll loop in Karthik and Soojin on the technical checklist.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(a) +1 415 555 0132

Attachments: 2026-07-14_MEDIQ_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF stub), redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx (Excel stub), draft-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (Word stub)

From: Amy Chen <amy@mediq.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediQ Procurement <procurement@mediq.com>, Ben Lowe <ben.lowe@mediq.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting selection — evaluation cadence & close-breakdown

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the doc set and the clear breakdown. Procurement will need:
- Estimated MRR and 12‑month sizing (we'll fill from your redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx)
- SOC 2 Type II attestation and data-retention policy (can you send SOC URL?)
- Draft contract term sheet + standard IP/LI clauses (send redlines by week 2)

Security also asked whether the POC can be scoped to avoid PHI ingestion in the first 2 weeks; they prefer Hosted for speed assuming CV encryption and no long-term storage of sample data. If we move to Dedicated or Private we'll need a longer procurement runway.

Tentatively we can aim for the final decision week of Aug 17 (gives internal reviews), but I want to keep the MAP cadence tight so we don’t slip.

Amy
Director, Platform Integrations — MediQ Health
amy@mediq.com

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP: hosting selection — evaluation cadence & close-breakdown

Aisha —

Noted. I'll prepare a short tech appendix we can attach to the MAP that covers:
- SOC 2 verifier link + compliance summary
- Encryption in transit/at rest + KMS options across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- POC data handling: recommendation to mask PHI and use synthetic payloads for weeks 1–2
- Estimated perf delta for small (≤128 token) vs long (≥2048 token) sequences for Hosted vs Dedicated (ballpark numbers)

I’ll drop the appendix into the Drive link and flag the MAP doc with a 'security appendix v1'.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: hosting selection — evaluation cadence & close-breakdown

Hi Amy/Ben —

Thanks — attaching the quick artifacts you asked for and updated the MAP with a decision checkpoint schedule. Highlights:
- Week 0 (now): sign MAP and SOW for Hosted POC (month-to-month billing)
- Weeks 1–2: POC (synthetic + redacted samples, no PHI ingestion) — observe latency/cost, run smoke tests
- Week 3: Optional Dedicated capacity test (if you request PHI stress test) — we can provision a Reserved pool for a 2-week window
- Week 4: Final acceptance tests and cost/quality review
- Decision checkpoint (target): 2026-08-17 — choose Hosted for production OR move to Dedicated/Private procurement path

Attachments included: short-rate-card.pdf (monthly hosted estimate), SOC2-link.txt (URL), MAP_v1.1.pdf (MAP updated), draft-SOW-hosted.pdf (SOW stub). I’ve also added a single-sheet comparison that shows the unit economics we expect at 1M tokens/day for Hosted vs Dedicated.

Next steps from our side: Karthik will share the security appendix; Soojin will coordinate a POC onboarding slot next week. From your side: procurement to confirm the minimal SOW redlines by 7/23 so we can kick Week 0.

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: short-rate-card.pdf (PDF stub), SOC2-link.txt (text stub), MAP_v1.1.pdf (PDF stub), draft-SOW-hosted.pdf (PDF stub)
